name: Resident Card, Worker Category (Carte de Resident + Attestation de Travail)

requirements.blocker_text: Original employer-issued work attestation, per the Ministry of Employment's rules on hiring foreign workers.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an Ivorian employer able to provide the attestation.

requirements.blocker_text: Mandatory online pre-enrollment through ONECI, plus a residence certificate under 6 months old.

evidence_required.document: Bank payment receipt (300,000 FCFA non-ECOWAS / 150,000 FCFA French nationals)

outcome.duration_length: requires periodic renewal; exact validity period not confirmed in sources fetched

sources.title: ONECI (Office National de l'Etat Civil et de l'Identification, Cote d'Ivoire) -- carte de resident, worker category: employer work attestation required, mandatory online pre-enrollment, residence certificate, fee 300,000 FCFA (non-ECOWAS nationals) / 150,000 FCFA (French nationals)
Fraternite Matin (Ivorian state-affiliated newspaper) -- August 2026 article reporting the Ministry of Employment's clarified rules on hiring foreign workers in Cote d'Ivoire

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Cote d'Ivoire). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- core requirements tier-1 ONECI sourced. A tier-4 news article (Fraternite Matin, an Ivorian state-affiliated but not itself governmental outlet) from August 2026 -- within days of this build -- reports the Ministry of Employment issuing clarified rules on foreign worker recruitment, suggesting active regulatory change in this exact area; the article's substance was not independently fetched in this pass and is flagged as a live-development signal worth re-checking rather than incorporated as a hard requirement. ECOWAS/CEDEAO nationals are NOT charged the standard 300,000 FCFA fee per ONECI's fee schedule (implying free movement treaty benefits for the regional bloc), but the exact ECOWAS-national work-authorization process was not separately confirmed and is not modeled as a distinct route here. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months are inferred from the general naturalisation residence threshold (see ci_citizenship_naturalisation.json), not independently confirmed for work-permit holders specifically.
